description: Full-text search over the pages of mondschein.com in one language: houses, rooms, dining, wellness, services, activities, area guides and blog articles. Use it when no other tool fits or to find the right page for a question ("dogs", "sauna", "Lech", "parking"). Returns up to 8 pages with title, kind, URL and a short snippet. Get details with the matching tool or give the guest the URL.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

name: search_site

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Search the website
